register_connector_ec_connector: register an EC connector with a name, module path, and class name in the factory registry
create_connector_vllm_config: create an EC connector instance from a VllmConfig and a specified ECConnectorRole
get_connector_class_ec_config: get the connector class by name from the registry or by importing the module path
build_ec_connector_factory: build an EC connector factory that lazily loads and creates connector instances
register_ec_example_connector: register the ECExampleConnector with the factory using its module path and class name
